name: Widened battleground lifted units scale damage and healing by the health lift ratio
contract: A level 12 Human Warrior (low) and a level 12 Human Priest (heal) of the Alliance enter a Warsong Gulch of the 10-29 bracket against two level 29 Orc Warriors (top, top2). The lift is health only and the lifted unit's damage and healing are multiplied by the ratio of lifted to own health, where a player's health is basehealth + PlayerStaminaHealth (20 + 10 per Stamina above 20). From player_class_stats: Warrior level 12 BaseHP 109 and Stamina 34 give 109 + 20 + 10 x 14 = 269; level 29 BaseHP 348 and Stamina 56 give 348 + 20 + 10 x 36 = 728; the Human race rows are zero. The Warrior ratio is 728 / 269 = 2.70632 and the maximum health gain is 239 base health + 22 Stamina x 10 = 459. Priest level 12 BaseHP 157 and Stamina 24 give 157 + 20 + 40 = 217; level 29 BaseHP 378 and Stamina 31 give 378 + 20 + 110 = 508; the Priest ratio is 508 / 217 = 2.34101. A level 29 Warrior is at the bracket top and has ratio 1. Mana, power and the primary stats Strength, Agility, Intellect and Spirit are not lifted and equal their snapshots before joining; low joins at full health and its health_pct is 100 at the lifted maximum, and after leaving at full health it is at full again. scaled_output is ScaledOutput itself: low to top with 1000 damage gives round(1000 x 2.70632) = 2706; low to the hostile Mortar Team Advanced Target Dummy (creature 12385, not a player, so no shared bracket top) gives 1000; low to heal, an ally, as damage gives 1000 because damage scales only against hostile targets; heal to low as healing with Flash Heal 2061 gives round(1000 x 2.34101) = 2341; heal to top as healing gives 1000 because top is hostile to heal and healing scales only on non-hostile targets; Infected 216 carries SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE_PERCENT and low to top with it gives 1000 (never scaled). Self healing scales: low to low as healing with Flash Heal 2061 gives round(1000 x 2.70632) = 2706, which keeps the leech rule below from passing by skipping every self heal. Drain Life 689 (coa-dbc-viewer record: Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with EffectApplyAuraName 53 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_LEECH, SchoolMask 32) builds the caster heal from the already scaled tick (SpellAuraEffects.cpp HandlePeriodicHealthLeechAuraTick), so the healing direction of a leech spell is never scaled again: low to low as healing with 689 gives 1000, while its damage direction low to top with 689 as damage still gives 2706. A heal that is a share of maximum health already follows the lifted health, so it is never scaled: low to low as healing gives 1000 with Lay on Hands 633 (coa-dbc-viewer record: Effect[0] 136 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT), with Lay on Hands 17233 (Effect 67 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_MAX_HEALTH) and with Cannibalize 20578 (EffectApplyAuraName 20 SPELL_AURA_OBS_MOD_HEALTH), while Flash Heal 2061 above still scales. Air Engraving 653226 (Runemaster; AscensionInheritsResolvedAmount is set in AscensionRunemasterDamageModifiers.cpp) is cast with BP0 equal to a percentage of damage the caster already dealt, which was scaled at its source, so the copy is never scaled again: low to top with 1000 damage and 653226 gives 1000. Wiring: Damage 100 (TEST) 2653 (coa-dbc-viewer record: Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints 99, EffectDieSides 1, SchoolMask 4 fire) deals 99 + 1 = 100 before scaling with no spell power coefficient on a Warrior. low casts it ten times at top, whose health is raised to 100000, and ten times at the dummy (creature 12385, creature_template level 6, no creature_template_resistance rows), whose health is refilled before each cast. Hits at top: the victim is a player with no fire resistance and both levels are within the vanilla range under ClassicPlus.CombatRules (default true, WorldConfig.cpp), so GetEffectiveResistChance takes the ClassicPlusCombat::SpellResistChance branch (Unit.cpp) with levelBased false for a player victim and resistance 0, giving a resist chance of 0, and PartialResistDistribution(0) interpolates from the first PartialResistTable row {0, 0, 0, 0, 0}, so every roll yields PartialResistMultiplier 0 and no partial resist occurs. Every non-critical landed hit at top is therefore round(100 x 2.70632) = 271 and the average (spell_damage_total ratio_to the non-critical spell_damage_count, misses excluded) lies in [270.9, 271.1]. Hits at the dummy: a creature victim uses linear monster resistance (CoA.MonsterResistance, PerLevel 1.0, PerPercent 5.0, MaxReductionPct 75.0), so partial resists do occur and an unscaled hit is at most the unresisted 100; the average is asserted at most 100, which an unscaled hit always satisfies. A scaled hit would fail it unless resisted by more than 1 - 100/271 = 63.1 percent, which needs the discrete resist outcome of at least 7 tenths; that outcome has probability 0 unless the average resist chance exceeds 0.5, that is a creature resistance above 250, while the dummy has the creature level of at most the bracket top 29 and no resistance rows (average resist chance at most 29 / 5 / 100 = 0.058, outcomes of at most 2 tenths, so a scaled hit is at least 271 x 0.8 = 216). The residual probability of a scaled hit passing the bound is therefore 0. After low leaves, its ratio is 1 and scaled_output low to top is 1000.
